key: makes great biryani for four friends
name: ch00_biryani_four_to_four_hundred
alt: Split illustration: a home cook serving biryani to four friends at home, and the same cook overwhelmed in a catering kitchen cooking for 400 guests.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, the same home cook appearing in both halves: a cheerful man in his early 30s with a trimmed beard, rolled-up sleeves on a mustard kurta and a red-checked kitchen towel over his shoulder. LEFT panel: a cosy apartment dining table at night under a warm pendant lamp, one steaming brass handi of biryani in the centre, four smiling friends in casual clothes reaching in with serving spoons, a bowl of raita and sliced onions beside it; the cook stands relaxed, proudly lifting the lid. RIGHT panel: a large catering kitchen with six huge copper deghs on gas burners, steam everywhere, stacks of steel plates, a wall clock reading quarter to eight, a clipboard order sheet pinned up reading "400 plates"; the same cook now sweats and looks worried, tasting from one pot while helpers rush past, a food-safety inspector with a clipboard watches from the doorway, and a guest at the serving hatch frowns over a complaint. Small icons float above the right kitchen: a rupee coin, a stopwatch and a warning triangle, showing cost, timing and safety. Warm golden light on the left, harsher busy white light on the right. Labels: "DEMO" at the top of the left panel, "PRODUCTION" at the top of the right panel.

key: Asking a new intern at a CA firm
name: ch00_ca_intern_gst_return
alt: A senior accountant hands a young intern written instructions and a client folder; three labels mark instructions, context and model.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a small chartered accountant's office in an Indian city: wooden desks, steel almirahs full of box files, a ceiling fan, a calendar on the wall and a window with afternoon light. In the centre a senior CA in her late 40s, wearing a cotton saree and reading glasses on a chain, stands beside a desk and hands over two things to a nervous young intern in his early 20s, in a pale blue formal shirt and ID lanyard, seated with a calculator and a laptop. In her right hand is a single sheet of handwritten instructions with a sticky note reading "March invoices"; in her left hand is a thick khaki client folder bulging with invoices and receipts. The intern looks eager but slightly unsure, a small thought bubble above his head showing a question mark and a tiny GST form. On the desk lies a blank tax return form waiting to be filled. In the background, a framed certificate and a shelf labelled with year numbers. Calm, warm afternoon light, a hint of deadline pressure from a wall clock. Labels: "INSTRUCTIONS" next to the handwritten sheet, "CONTEXT" on the khaki folder, "MODEL" directly under the intern's chair.

key: Electricity in India. Very few compan
name: ch01_power_plant_kirana_fridge
alt: A distant power plant sends electricity along pylons to many small kirana shops, one of which plugs in a cold-drinks fridge.
scene: A wide panoramic illustration read from left to right. On the far LEFT, on a hilltop, a huge power plant with cooling towers and a fenced compound stands under a clear sky, with engineers in hard hats tiny beside the giant turbines. From it, a line of tall transmission pylons carries glowing cables across fields towards the RIGHT, where a busy Indian neighbourhood street is lined with small shops. In the foreground right, a cheerful kirana shop owner in his 40s, wearing a white vest under an open checked shirt, is plugging the cord of a bright glass-door fridge full of cold drink bottles into a wall socket; children in school uniform are already pointing at the cold bottles. Next door, a tailor uses an electric sewing machine and a photocopy shop runs its copier, all from the same wires. Small glowing pulses travel along the cables to show power flowing from the one plant to many shops. Midday sun, bright and optimistic mood, a few crows on the wires. Labels: "MODEL LABS" under the power plant, "AI ENGINEERS" under the row of shops, with a small arrow pointing to the kirana owner's plug.

key: A new cook in a dhaba first makes staf
name: ch01_dhaba_staff_meal_first
alt: A new dhaba cook first serves a staff meal to coworkers in the back, before cooking for paying customers out front.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, showing two moments in the same roadside dhaba. LEFT panel, the back kitchen in the afternoon: a young new cook, about 19, in a white vest and a loosely tied apron, serves dal and rotis onto steel plates for four dhaba staff sitting on a wooden bench and charpai: a waiter with a towel on his shoulder, a dishwasher, the cashier and an old helper. The dal is slightly watery and one roti is burnt, but the staff laugh, shrug and keep eating; one gives a forgiving thumbs-up. RIGHT panel, the front of the dhaba at night with string lights: the same cook, now a little more confident, carries a full thali to a family of paying customers seated at a plastic table near trucks parked on the highway; the father studies the food critically while the owner watches from the cash counter. A dotted arrow runs from the left panel to the right, showing learning carried forward. Warm afternoon light on the left, festive evening light on the right. Labels: "INTERNAL TOOLS" at the top of the left panel, "CUSTOMERS" at the top of the right panel.

key: Learning to drive in India: first the
name: ch01_driving_crawl_walk_run
alt: Three panels show a learner driver progressing from a dual-brake instructor car, to a quiet colony with family, to a highway alone.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip illustration, panels separated by thin white gaps, following the same learner driver: a young woman in her mid 20s with a ponytail, kurti and jeans, gripping the steering wheel. PANEL ONE: inside a driving-school hatchback with an L sign on the bonnet, a stern instructor in a grey safari suit sits in the passenger seat with his own foot hovering over a second brake pedal, highlighted with a small circle, and his hand raised to approve each turn; she looks tense. PANEL TWO: a quiet residential colony lane lined with gulmohar trees and parked scooters, her father in the passenger seat and her younger brother in the back giving relaxed advice, a dog watching from a gate; she is smiling and more at ease. PANEL THREE: an open four-lane highway at sunrise with trucks and distant hills, she drives alone with sunglasses on, calm and confident, other cars and buses around her representing real traffic. A small arrow runs along the bottom of all three panels showing progression. Bright morning light throughout. Labels: "CRAWL" at the top of panel one, "WALK" at the top of panel two, "RUN" at the top of panel three.

key: Prompting is giving a skilled cook a d
name: ch01_order_slip_vs_training
alt: Split image: a customer hands a cook a detailed order slip, versus the cook spending a month training in a mother's home kitchen.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, the same skilled cook in both halves: a man in his late 30s with a white chef's cap, a neat moustache and a grey apron. LEFT panel: a busy restaurant pass counter, a customer in an office shirt slides a small handwritten order slip across to the cook; the slip reads "less oil, extra jeera"; behind him a spike holds a long stack of identical slips and a small rupee coin floats beside each one, showing that the instruction must be repeated and paid for on every order. The cook reads it carefully. RIGHT panel: a warm home kitchen with a steel spice dabba, a pressure cooker and a calendar showing a whole month crossed off; an elderly mother in a cotton saree stands beside the cook, guiding his hand as he tempers spices in a kadai; the cook concentrates and nods, absorbing the method so it becomes his own habit. A small inset in the corner shows a second, different cook arriving with a blank notebook, hinting the training must be redone for each new cook. Warm, homely lighting. Labels: "PROMPTING" at the top of the left panel, "FINETUNING" at the top of the right panel.

key: A librarian at a big college library.
name: ch02_librarian_attention
alt: A college librarian compares a student's question slip against catalogue cards and hands back a blend of pages from the best-matching books.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a grand old college library with tall wooden shelves, green reading lamps and arched windows. In the foreground, a student in his early 20s with a backpack and a checked shirt stands at the issue counter holding up a small slip of paper with a question mark on it. Behind the counter, a kind librarian in her 50s with spectacles and a handloom saree runs her finger along a long wooden drawer of catalogue cards; thin glowing lines connect the student's slip to every card, some lines thick and bright, others faint, showing match strength. To the right of the counter, three open books lie side by side and loose pages are being drawn out of them in different amounts, a thick bundle from the brightest match and only a sliver from the faintest, flowing together into one blended stack handed to the student. In the background, several other librarians at separate desks each examine the same slip from a different angle, one with an author list, one with a calendar, hinting at multiple heads. Soft warm library light, quiet and focused mood. Labels: "QUERY" next to the student's slip, "KEYS" on the catalogue drawer, "VALUES" under the open books.

key: Mixture-of-experts is a big hospital
name: ch02_moe_hospital_two_doctors
alt: A hospital corridor with eight specialist doctors' rooms; a receptionist routes a patient to only two of them while the other six stay idle.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated view of a long, clean hospital corridor in an Indian multi-speciality hospital, with eight doctor consultation rooms in a row, each door open and a specialist doctor in a white coat visible inside: a cardiologist with a heart model, an orthopaedic surgeon with an X-ray, a dermatologist, an eye doctor, an ENT, a neurologist, a paediatrician with toys and a dentist. At the near end of the corridor, a receptionist in a navy uniform at a curved desk looks at an elderly patient in a white kurta-pyjama holding a cane and a file, and points with two glowing arrows towards just two doors, the cardiologist and the neurologist, whose rooms are brightly lit. The other six rooms are dimmer, their doctors reading or sipping tea, clearly idle for this patient. Above the corridor, a large payroll board shows eight name plates, all lit, to show the hospital pays and houses all eight. Clean daylight through tall windows, calm efficient mood. Labels: "ROUTER" directly above the receptionist's desk, "ACTIVE EXPERTS" over the two lit doors, "ALL EXPERTS" on the payroll board.

key: Temperature is the spice level you ask
name: ch02_temperature_spice_level
alt: Three plates from a Chettinad restaurant chef: a plain standard dish, a medium dish with a little flair, and a wild fiery dish a diner can't eat.
scene: A wide horizontal illustration of an open restaurant kitchen counter in a South Indian Chettinad restaurant, with brass lamps, banana leaves and red chillies hanging in strings. Behind the counter a chef in his 40s, with a thick moustache, white veshti and a chef's jacket, stands at the centre with a large dial on the wall behind him, like a stove knob, marked from cool blue on the left to fiery red on the right. In front of him three plates on banana leaves are set out left to right. LEFT plate: a neat, identical standard chicken curry, a little plain, with a diner in a formal shirt nodding politely but looking bored. MIDDLE plate: the same curry with a small creative garnish of curry leaves and a coconut swirl, a happy diner smiling with eyes closed. RIGHT plate: a wild, steaming creation with chillies sticking out and odd colours, a diner fanning his mouth with tears in his eyes and reaching for water. The dial's needle points to the middle setting. Warm, lively evening light, playful mood. Labels: "LOW" above the left plate, "0.7" above the middle plate, "HIGH" above the right plate.

key: Asking a crowded tea stall
name: ch02_tea_stall_crowd_lottery
alt: A crowd at a tea stall shouts different cricketer names to a question; their voices funnel into one speaker drawing a weighted lottery ticket.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a crowded roadside tea stall at dusk, with a blue tarpaulin roof, a big aluminium kettle on a stove and glasses of chai on a steel tray. A curious young man in a hoodie stands at the front asking a question, shown as a speech bubble with a cricket bat and a question mark. Around the stall about fifteen people of all ages, office workers, auto drivers, a college student and an old man with a newspaper, all shout at once; most of their speech bubbles show the same blue cricket helmet icon, a few show a different helmet icon, and one man at the edge shouts with a bubble showing a small unknown player in whites. In the background these speech bubbles flow like streams into a single large tin funnel, which feeds a lottery drum where coloured balls are mixed, most of them blue, a few another colour, one odd ball. A single loudspeaker on top of the drum announces one answer with the same confident volume, whichever ball comes out. Warm streetlight glow, chatty, lively mood. Labels: "TRAINING DATA" on the crowd, "SAMPLING" on the lottery drum.

key: A chai-wala who has served the same of
name: ch03_chaiwala_cross_entropy
alt: A chai-wala calmly preparing a regular office worker's usual order, contrasted with the same man confused by unfamiliar tourists' orders.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, the same chai-wala in both halves: a wiry man in his 40s with a grey moustache, a checked lungi and a towel on his shoulder, pouring tea from a height. LEFT panel: a small stall at the gate of an office building, morning light; an accountant in a sleeveless sweater and glasses walks in with his briefcase and the chai-wala is already handing him a small cutting glass of tea before he speaks, a tiny thought bubble showing the same cutting glass; the chai-wala looks calm and smug, regulars chatting nearby. RIGHT panel: a stall near a busy tourist monument with camels or a fort in the background; a group of foreign and out-of-town tourists with cameras and maps all speak at once, their speech bubbles showing iced coffee, green tea and a lemon; the same chai-wala looks surprised, eyebrows raised, sweat drop on his forehead, several large exclamation marks popping above his head. Warm morning glow on the left, harsh noon sun on the right. Labels: "LOW SURPRISE" at the top of the left panel, "HIGH SURPRISE" at the top of the right panel.

key: A senior chef tasting every dish befor
name: ch03_senior_chef_ai_judge
alt: A senior chef tastes every dish at the kitchen pass before it goes out, instead of waiting for customers to fill feedback forms.
scene: A wide three-quarter view of a busy restaurant kitchen pass at dinner time. In the centre, a senior head chef in his 50s with a white double-breasted jacket, a tall toque and a stern but fair face stands at the steel pass, dipping a small spoon into each plate as cooks push dishes towards him: paneer butter masala, dal makhani, a biryani bowl. Beside him he places small tags on the plates: a green tick on most, and a red cross on one with a short note pinned to it, showing he can explain why a dish failed. To the right, waiters carry approved plates out through swinging doors. On the far left, half in shadow, an untouched stack of paper feedback forms sits on a stool, gathering dust, with one waiter shrugging at it. A subtle hint of bias: on the chef's side of the counter, his own signature recipe card is pinned up, and he is smiling slightly more at the dish that matches it. Warm, steamy kitchen light, energetic mood. Labels: "AI JUDGE" directly under the head chef, "OUTPUTS" over the line of plates.

key: A debate competition judge who
name: ch03_debate_judge_biases
alt: A debate judge shows three biases: favouring his own college's speaker, remembering the first speaker, and rewarding the longest speech.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated view of a school auditorium hosting an inter-college debate, with a banner-less stage, two wooden podiums and rows of students in the audience. At a long judges' table in front, a single judge in his 50s with a waistcoat and a college tie sits with a scoresheet. On stage, three speakers wait in a line: the first, a young woman in a blazer, has a college crest badge identical to the one on the judge's tie, and a small heart icon floats between them; the second, a nervous young man, stands in the middle almost faded; the third, a talkative student, holds a very long scroll of speech that unrolls down the stage steps. Above the judge's head a thought cloud shows the first speaker highlighted large and the others small. In the corner of the image an inset shows fixes: a hand covering a college crest with a blank sticker, two speakers swapping positions with curved arrows, and an hourglass. Warm stage lighting with a spotlight on the podiums. Labels: "SELF BIAS" near the matching crests, "POSITION BIAS" above the first speaker, "VERBOSITY" next to the long scroll.

key: An eye test: the optometrist doesn
name: ch03_eye_test_lens_comparison
alt: An optometrist flips between two lenses asking a patient which is better, rather than asking for a score out of ten.
scene: A close, eye-level three-quarter view inside a small optometry clinic. A patient, a middle-aged man in a striped shirt, sits in an examination chair with a heavy phoropter device in front of his face. Beside him, a friendly optometrist in her 30s in a white coat with her hair tied back flips a lever on the device, and two round lens icons float above it, one marked "1" and one marked "2", with curved arrows switching between them. A speech bubble from the patient shows him pointing at lens 2, and a small tally on her clipboard shows a sequence of ticks under alternating lenses. In the background on the far wall, a lit eye chart with rows of letters getting smaller, slightly blurred, with a small inset showing a car and steering wheel next to the chart, hinting that a separate absolute test is still needed before driving. A crossed-out sticky note on the desk reads "1-10". Calm, soft clinical lighting with a cool blue tint. Labels: "PAIRWISE" above the two floating lenses, "ABSOLUTE TEST" next to the eye chart.

key: Hiring a cook for your dhaba. Part 1
name: ch04_hiring_dhaba_cook
alt: Three-step scene of a dhaba owner hiring a cook: writing the job description, shortlisting candidates, and a trial week with regular customers.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip illustration, panels separated by thin white gaps, following a dhaba owner: a sturdy man in his 50s with a turban, a white kurta and a pen behind his ear. PANEL ONE: at his cash counter he writes on a board with chalk, four simple icons listed: a bowl of dal, a sparkling clean pan, a stopwatch and a rupee symbol. PANEL TWO: outside the dhaba, a queue of a dozen cooks in aprons; he holds a short list on a clipboard and waves most of them away, with three cooks stepping forward holding reference letters, one wearing a small night moon badge. PANEL THREE: inside the dhaba during a lunch rush, one chosen cook in a white vest serves dishes to three regular customers, a truck driver, a college student and a policeman, who taste the food; the owner watches closely with a notebook, and the regulars give thumbs up and one thoughtful frown. A small arrow runs left to right beneath the panels. Bright daytime light, practical, hopeful mood. Labels: "CRITERIA" at the top of panel one, "SHORTLIST" at the top of panel two, "YOUR OWN EVAL" at the top of panel three.

key: Renting a flat vs owning a house.
name: ch04_renting_vs_owning_model
alt: Split image: a tenant in a rented flat whose landlord sets rules and repaints without asking, versus a homeowner knocking down a wall and fixing a leak alone.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a tidy rented apartment in a city high-rise; a young tenant in his late 20s in a t-shirt and shorts relaxes on a sofa with a laptop while a landlord in a white kurta and gold watch stands at the door holding a printed rule sheet with a padlock icon; a plumber is fixing the sink in the background at the landlord's expense, and outside the window a painter on a ladder is repainting the balcony a new colour without asking, the tenant looking up surprised. A small "FOR SALE" sign leans against the building entrance. RIGHT panel: an independent house; the same young man, now in work clothes with a hammer, has knocked out part of an inner wall to make an open kitchen, a solar panel sits on the roof and a water tank shows off-grid living; but a pipe is leaking onto the floor and he is mopping it himself, looking tired but in control. Calm daylight on both sides. Labels: "API" at the top of the left panel, "SELF-HOSTED" at the top of the right panel, "FINETUNE" on the broken wall.

key: A coaching centre that teaches last ye
name: ch04_coaching_centre_contamination
alt: A coaching class drills last year's exact exam paper; students ace it but are lost when handed a fresh paper.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a crowded coaching centre classroom with fluorescent tube lights, rows of wooden benches and a whiteboard; a teacher in a formal shirt and tie taps a pointer on a projected copy of last year's question paper with a bold "2023" in the corner; students in school uniforms chant and copy word for word, and a big marksheet on the wall reads "98%". RIGHT panel: an exam hall with spaced desks and a ceiling fan; the same students look at a fresh question paper with a different layout and new diagrams; they scratch their heads, sweat, and stare blankly, one student's sheet empty. At the front, an examiner in a saree holds a magnifying glass over one answer sheet beside an open guidebook, checking for word-for-word matching passages, while another invigilator raises an eyebrow at a student writing suspiciously fast with a little speed line. Harsh flat light on the left, quiet tense light on the right. Labels: "CONTAMINATED" at the top of the left panel, "FRESH TEST" at the top of the right panel, "N-GRAM CHECK" next to the magnifying glass.

key: Before trusting a weighing scale at th
name: ch04_mandi_scale_calibration
alt: A vegetable seller tests his weighing scale with a known 1 kg weight and gets two different readings, showing the scale itself is unreliable.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a busy sabzi mandi at early morning, with gunny sacks of onions, piles of tomatoes, green chillies and bright plastic crates under tarpaulin sheds. In the centre, a careful buyer, a woman in her 40s in a cotton salwar suit with a cloth shopping bag, stands at a vendor's wooden stall. The vendor, a young man in a vest and a cap, places a single shiny black cast-iron weight marked "1 kg" onto a dial weighing scale. Two inset bubbles above the scale show two moments: in the first the needle points to "980 g", in the second the needle points to "1030 g". The buyer frowns and points at the scale, not at the onions, which sit unweighed in a basket. In the background, a second stall shows the vendor swapping in a completely different scale, with a small calendar page flipping, showing that changing scales each week breaks comparisons. Soft golden early-morning light, dusty, bustling market mood. Labels: "KNOWN INPUT" next to the 1 kg weight, "EVAL PIPELINE" under the scale.

key: Ordering at a tailor: "Make a kurta
name: ch05_tailor_kurta_prompt
alt: A customer at a tailor's shop gives instructions, shows an old favourite kurta as an example, and hands over cloth to be stitched.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view inside a small Indian tailor's shop, with bolts of colourful fabric on wooden shelves, a black treadle sewing machine, a measuring tape hanging from a hook and a calendar on the wall. A customer in his 30s, wearing glasses and a casual shirt, stands at the cutting table and does three things at once arranged from left to right: with one hand gesturing as he speaks, a speech bubble showing a slim kurta outline and a collar; with his other hand holding up an old, faded but well-loved kurta as a sample; and on the table a neatly folded length of new indigo cotton cloth that he has just placed down. Opposite him, an elderly tailor in his 60s with a white beard, a tape measure around his neck and spectacles on his nose listens closely, chalk in hand. A small inset in the corner shows the tailor looking confused with a big question mark when the sample kurta is missing. Warm daylight through a shop window, friendly mood. Labels: "TASK DESCRIPTION" by the speech bubble, "EXAMPLE" on the old kurta, "INPUT" on the new cloth.

key: A long WhatsApp voice note from a rel
name: ch05_voice_note_lost_middle
alt: A young man listens to a long voice note on his phone; the beginning and end are clear but the middle part is foggy.
scene: A wide horizontal illustration. In the foreground on the left, a young man in his mid 20s in a hoodie lies on a sofa in a small rented flat at night, holding a phone to his ear, one eyebrow raised, a cup of tea going cold on a side table. Above him, stretching across the whole top of the image from left to right, is a very long audio waveform ribbon, like a voice note timeline. The LEFT end of the ribbon is crisp and bright, with a small illustration of a smiling aunt in a saree waving, representing the start. The RIGHT end is also crisp and bright, showing the same aunt pointing at a calendar with a Sunday circled. The long MIDDLE section of the ribbon is blurred and covered in grey fog, with faint ghostly images of several uncles and medicine bottles barely visible inside it. Small dotted lines from the young man's ear reach the bright ends but fade out before the middle. Soft lamp light in the room, cosy but slightly confused mood. Labels: "START" over the left end, "END" over the right end, "LOST MIDDLE" in the fog.

key: A hospital OPD. The reception desk do
name: ch05_opd_triage_routing
alt: A hospital OPD reception clerk sorts a queue of patients and sends each one down a different corridor to cardiology, orthopaedics or general medicine.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a busy government hospital OPD hall with green walls, plastic chairs and ceiling fans. In the centre, a reception desk with a young receptionist in a white uniform and a lanyard, quickly listening to each patient and pointing. A long queue of patients waits before her: an old man clutching his chest, a teenage boy with an arm in a sling, a woman with a cough and a scarf over her mouth, a farmer with a cloth bag. Behind the desk, three corridors branch out like a fork, each with an icon above its entrance: a heart, a bone and a stethoscope. Coloured arrows lead each patient to the correct corridor, the chest-pain man to the heart corridor, the boy to the bone corridor. At the end of each corridor a doctor in a white coat waits at a consulting room door. One small detail: a patient with a cough has been sent by a faint red arrow down the bone corridor, and a small warning icon floats there, hinting that misrouting goes unnoticed. Clean daylight, organised but busy mood. Labels: "CLASSIFY INTENT" directly under the reception desk, "SPECIALIST PROMPTS" over the three corridors.

key: Your trusted house help reads notes l
name: ch05_house_help_forged_note
alt: A house help reads two similar notes stuck to the door, one real from the homeowner and one forged by a stranger asking to hand over the spare key.
scene: A wide three-quarter view of the front door of a middle-class Indian flat in an apartment building corridor, with a shoe rack, a nameplate, a hanging marigold toran and a potted tulsi plant. A trusted house help, a woman in her 40s in a printed cotton saree with her pallu tucked in and a broom in one hand, stands at the open door reading two paper notes taped to it. Both notes look almost identical, plain white paper with similar handwriting. The left note, taped by the owner earlier, shows a small sketch of a milk packet. The right note, newly slipped under the door, shows a small key sketch and an arrow to a man in a blue shirt. In the background at the end of the corridor near the lift, a stranger in a bright blue shirt and sunglasses waits casually with his hands in his pockets, a sly half-smile. The house help looks puzzled, holding a spare key on a ring, unsure which note to trust. Soft corridor tube light, slightly suspenseful mood. Labels: "TRUSTED" over the left note, "INJECTED" over the right note, "PROMPT INJECTION" near the stranger.

key: The indexing is the owner arranging st
name: ch06_kirana_rag_pipeline
alt: A kirana shop shown in three steps: the owner labelling shelves at night, a helper boy fetching requested items, and the owner packing the bag at the counter.
scene: A wide panoramic illustration of one small Indian kirana shop shown as a left-to-right sequence. On the LEFT, set at night with a single bulb, the shop owner, a plump man in his 50s wearing a white vest and a dhoti, stands on a stool sticking hand-written labels on wooden shelves stocked with noodle packets, biscuit packets, rice sacks and oil tins. In the CENTRE, in bright morning light, a customer in her 30s in a salwar suit with a cloth bag speaks a request shown as a speech bubble with a noodle packet and a biscuit packet icon; a skinny helper boy of about 14 in a school-style half-sleeve shirt sprints towards the labelled shelves, reaching up to grab exactly those packets. On the RIGHT, the owner sits at the wooden counter with a small calculator and a notebook, packing the fetched items into the customer's bag and telling her the total, a small rupee icon above. A tiny inset at the bottom right shows a mislabelled shelf and the boy holding the wrong packet, hinting that bad indexing ruins the result. Labels: "INDEXING" above the left section, "RETRIEVAL" above the running boy, "GENERATION" above the counter.

key: Cutting a big birthday cake for a par
name: ch06_birthday_cake_chunking
alt: A birthday cake with lettering cut three ways: tiny slices that split the words, huge slices for few guests, and overlapping slices that keep the words intact.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip illustration, panels separated by thin white gaps, each showing the same large rectangular birthday cake from directly above on a party table with balloons and paper plates around it. The cake has pink icing and simple piped lettering reading "Happy Birthday Riya". PANEL ONE: the cake is cut into many tiny squares by a thin grid of cuts, and the lettering is split so one square shows "Happy Bir" and the next shows "thday Riya"; many children's hands reach in from all sides, each grabbing a small piece. PANEL TWO: the same cake cut into just three huge slabs, lettering intact on one, with only three guests holding big plates while other children in the background look disappointed with empty plates. PANEL THREE: the cake cut into medium slices with thin translucent bands where neighbouring slices share a strip of extra cake, so the full words survive within at least one slice, and a smiling girl in a party hat holds that slice up proudly. Bright, cheerful party lighting with confetti. Labels: "SMALL CHUNKS" at the top of panel one, "LARGE CHUNKS" at the top of panel two, "OVERLAP" at the top of panel three.

key: A brilliant shopkeeper who is bad at
name: ch06_shopkeeper_calculator_tools
alt: A shopkeeper behind his counter uses a calculator, a bill printer and a translator app to serve customers, including tourists.
scene: A wide, eye-level three-quarter view of a busy shop counter in an Indian market lane, with shelves of steel utensils and plastic goods behind. A brilliant, chatty shopkeeper in his 40s with a neat side parting, a striped shirt and a pen in his pocket stands behind the counter. In front of him on the glass counter lie three tools in a row from left to right: a large-button calculator he is tapping confidently, a small thermal bill printer spitting out a receipt, and a smartphone on a stand showing a translation screen with two speech bubbles, one in Devanagari-like squiggles and one in Latin-like squiggles. Above his head a faint thought bubble shows tangled numbers with a cross through it, showing he is bad at mental maths. In front of the counter, a local customer takes the printed bill while a foreign tourist couple with a backpack and a map smile as the phone speaks to them. A tiny detail: he must still choose which tool to pick up, shown by a small question mark hovering between his hand and the tools. Bright market daylight, friendly mood. Labels: "AGENT" directly under the shopkeeper, "TOOLS" under the row of devices.

key: A detective in a Hindi crime serial:
name: ch06_detective_react_loop
alt: A TV-serial detective moves in a loop: thinking aloud, questioning a dhobi, listening to his story, and revising his theory before naming the culprit.
scene: A circular-loop illustration arranged like a clock face around a central evidence board. At the centre, a cork board with photos, red string and a question mark. Around it, four scenes of the same detective, a man in his 40s with a thick moustache, aviator sunglasses pushed up on his head and a brown leather jacket, connected by curved arrows going clockwise. TOP: he stands with a hand on his chin, a thought bubble showing a shirt with a stain, thinking aloud. RIGHT: he walks into a riverside dhobi ghat with lines of washed white sheets drying and asks a dhobi in a vest and lungi a question. BOTTOM: the dhobi, holding a wet shirt, explains animatedly while the detective writes in a small notebook. LEFT: back at the board, he moves a red string to a different photo, crossing out an earlier suspect. A final arrow breaks out of the loop to the far right corner where he points dramatically at a suspect silhouette. Moody evening light with dramatic shadows, TV-serial suspense. Labels: "THOUGHT" by the top scene, "ACTION" by the right scene, "OBSERVATION" by the bottom scene.

key: A chef trained in North Indian cooking
name: ch07_chef_transfer_learning
alt: A North Indian chef brings her existing knife and tempering skills into a South Indian kitchen and practises only dosa and sambar.
scene: A wide three-quarter view of a bright South Indian restaurant kitchen, with a large flat dosa tawa, a pot of bubbling sambar, banana leaves, a coconut grater and steel tumblers. At the centre, a confident woman chef in her 30s wearing a chef's jacket over a salwar, with a dupatta tied back, practises spreading dosa batter in a spiral with a ladle. Behind her, a glowing translucent backpack-like bundle floats from her shoulders, containing icons of skills she already has: a chef's knife, a small tadka pan with spices, and a kitchen timer. A small inset on the left shows a faded memory of her in a North Indian kitchen making rotis in a tandoor, with a dotted arrow from that inset to the backpack. A wall calendar shows just three weeks marked, and an older South Indian cook in a white veshti watches approvingly, giving a nod. Off to the side, a framed culinary school certificate hangs with a small cross over a second enrolment form, showing she does not need to go back to school. Warm morning kitchen light, encouraging mood. Labels: "PRE-TRAINED SKILLS" on the floating bundle, "FINETUNING" under the dosa tawa.

key: Moving house in a tempo. Inference is
name: ch07_tempo_training_memory
alt: Two tempos compared: one carrying only furniture for inference, the other overloaded with furniture plus three big notebooks for gradients and optimizer states.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, each half showing a small Indian goods tempo, a three-wheeler with an open cargo bed, on a residential street outside an apartment block. LEFT panel: the tempo carries a neat load of furniture tied with rope: a sofa, a steel almirah, a dining table and a few chairs; the driver, a cheerful man in a khaki uniform, leans relaxed against the cab. RIGHT panel: an identical tempo hugely overloaded; on top of the same furniture are stacked three giant notebooks each as big as the almirah itself, one labelled with a small pencil icon, two others with spiral bindings and scribbled notes spilling out; the tempo's tyres are flattened, the suspension sags, and the driver wipes sweat while a second, larger truck waits behind. A small inset in the bottom corner shows the same furniture shrunk to half size in a much smaller tempo, hinting at quantization and fewer items. Bright midday sun, comic moving-day mood. Labels: "INFERENCE" at the top of the left panel, "TRAINING" at the top of the right panel, "GRADIENTS + OPTIMIZER" on the giant notebooks.

key: Altering a ready-made kurta instead
name: ch07_lora_kurta_alteration
alt: A tailor stitches a thin contrasting strip along a few seams of a ready-made kurta to change its fit, instead of making a new one.
scene: A close, slightly elevated view of a tailor's work table in a small Indian alteration shop, with spools of thread, scissors, a pin cushion and a measuring tape. A large ready-made white cotton kurta lies flat across the table, filling most of the frame. An elderly tailor in his 60s with spectacles and a skull cap carefully stitches a very thin strip of saffron fabric along the side seams and under the sleeves; the strip is clearly tiny compared with the whole kurta. Beside him, the customer, a slim young man in a vest, waits with a delighted face, and a small inset bubble shows him wearing the kurta afterwards with a perfect fit. On a shelf in the background, an untouched bolt of new cloth and a tape-measure pattern for a full new kurta are pushed aside, showing nobody is stitching from scratch. A small weight scale at the edge shows the altered kurta weighing the same as before. Warm afternoon light through a window grille, patient craft mood. Labels: "FROZEN WEIGHTS" on the kurta body, "LORA" next to the thin saffron strip.

key: Two family recipes for garam masala
name: ch07_garam_masala_task_vectors
alt: Grandma's base garam masala with two family members' twists separated out and then both added back to create a combined blend.
scene: A wide horizontal illustration of a warm family kitchen with a steel masala dabba, a stone grinder and jars on a wooden shelf. At the centre, a smiling grandmother in her 70s in a white cotton saree sits on a low stool beside a large clay bowl of her original garam masala. To her left, her daughter in her 40s holds a small jar of her own masala; to her right, her grandson in his 20s holds another small jar. From each jar a small glowing spoon lifts out just the difference from grandma's recipe: from the daughter's jar a spoon of extra cardamom pods, from the grandson's jar a spoon of black pepper. Curved arrows carry these two spoons into grandma's bowl in the centre, where a new blended bowl sits slightly in front, glowing. In a small corner inset, a spoon of a clashing ingredient is being lifted out of a bowl, showing subtraction. Spice dust floats in a shaft of sunlight and everyone leans in to smell the result, curious and pleased. Labels: "BASE MODEL" under grandma's bowl, "TASK VECTORS" over the two spoons, "MERGED" under the new bowl.

key: Every restaurant on the street buys th
name: ch08_same_stove_secret_recipe
alt: A street of dhabas all using the same stove and tawa, with one famous dhaba standing out because of its owner's ingredients and recipe notebook.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a highway food street with four dhabas side by side, each with an open cooking area facing the road. Every dhaba has exactly the same black gas stove and the same round iron tawa, drawn identically to make the point. The three dhabas on the left are quiet, with a few customers and bored cooks. The fourth dhaba on the right is packed, with a long queue, trucks parked outside and a hand-painted board with a star. Its owner, a cheerful Sikh man in his 50s with a turban, apron and rolled sleeves, stands at the identical stove but beside him is a wooden table loaded with fresh, carefully chosen ingredients: whole spices in small bowls, fresh tomatoes, ghee in a brass pot, and a worn, thick recipe notebook with many bookmarks, glowing slightly. A small inset in the corner shows him at night tasting from a spoon and writing in the notebook. Golden late-afternoon light, lively roadside mood. Labels: "SAME MODEL" with an arrow to the row of identical stoves, "YOUR DATA" on the ingredients and notebook.

key: A flight simulator for pilot training
name: ch08_flight_simulator_synthetic
alt: A trainee pilot practises an engine failure in a flight simulator while an instructor replays the same scenario repeatedly, with no passengers at risk.
scene: A wide three-quarter view inside a flight simulator training room. In the centre, a large white simulator pod on hydraulic legs, its side cut away to reveal the cockpit inside. In the cockpit, a young trainee pilot in her mid 20s with a white shirt, epaulettes and a headset grips the controls with focus, while the wraparound screen shows a stormy sky and one engine trailing smoke, a red warning light flashing on the panel. Behind her, a calm senior instructor in his 50s with grey hair sits at a console with a big replay button and a counter showing a high number of attempts, ready to restart the same exact scenario. Outside the pod, on the floor of the training hall, a row of empty passenger seats sits safely untouched to show nobody is at risk. In a small corner inset, a cracked physics textbook beside the console hints that a simulator built on wrong physics trains bad pilots. Cool blue screen glow mixed with warm room light, focused mood. Labels: "SYNTHETIC DATA" on the simulator pod, "RARE EVENTS" next to the smoking engine.

key: photocopying a photocopy of a photocop
name: ch08_photocopy_model_collapse
alt: A row of five photocopies of the same page, each copy losing faint pencil notes until only the bold headings remain.
scene: A wide horizontal illustration of a small Indian photocopy shop counter, with a big grey copier machine on the left and a young shop assistant in a polo shirt feeding paper into it. From the copier, a row of five sheets of paper is laid out from left to right on the long counter, each one a copy of the one before, connected by small curved arrows. The FIRST sheet on the left is crisp: a bold heading, neat paragraphs, a small diagram, and faint light pencil notes and a tiny doodle in the margin. The SECOND sheet has slightly greyer text and the pencil notes are already fainter. The THIRD has lost the margin notes almost entirely and the diagram is blurry. The FOURTH shows only smudgy paragraphs. The FIFTH on the far right shows only the bold heading and a few thick black blocks, everything else gone. A college student in a hoodie stands at the end looking puzzled at the last sheet. Fluorescent shop light, slightly humorous mood. Labels: "REAL DATA" above the first sheet, "RARE DETAILS LOST" above the third sheet, "COLLAPSE" above the last sheet.

key: Sorting rice before cooking:
name: ch08_sorting_rice_data_cleaning
alt: A woman sorting rice on a steel plate in three stages: removing stones and husk, discarding forbidden grains, and keeping only the best grains for the pot.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated view of a sunlit Indian home courtyard or kitchen floor. A woman in her 50s with greying hair in a bun and a cotton saree sits cross-legged on a mat, with three wide steel plates arranged in front of her from left to right and a cooking pot on the far right. On the FIRST plate, she picks small stones, husk and bits of straw out of a heap of raw rice and flicks them into a small waste bowl. On the SECOND plate, she removes a few discoloured and odd grains marked with a small red stop symbol, dropping them into a separate covered tin, showing things not allowed to be served. On the THIRD plate, she gently sweeps only the whitest, longest grains towards the pot, while a surplus of decent grains is pushed aside into a sack because the pot is already nearly full. Golden morning sunlight streams across the floor, a sparrow pecking at fallen husk nearby, calm domestic mood. Labels: "REMOVE JUNK" above the first plate, "REMOVE PII" above the second plate, "FILTER" above the third plate.

key: A dosa counter. Prefill is the cook
name: ch09_dosa_prefill_decode
alt: A dosa cook prepares all batter and fillings in one go, then serves dosas one by one, walking each time to a big tawa at the back.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, the same dosa cook in both halves: a man in his 30s with a white vest, a red-checked lungi folded at the knee and a towel on his shoulder. LEFT panel: at the front prep counter, he reads a long order slip pinned up, and with many arms drawn in a playful multi-arm style he simultaneously ladles batter into bowls, chops onions, mashes potato masala and grinds chutney, all happening at once in a burst of activity. RIGHT panel: the same cook now carries a single plate, walking along a long dotted path to a big round tawa at the far back of the kitchen, making one dosa, then walking back to the serving counter where one waiting customer receives dosa number 1 while a queue of plates numbered 2, 3 and 4 wait empty. Footprints along the path emphasise the walking. A tiny inset shows him glancing at a small ledger card rather than re-reading the slip. Warm, bustling breakfast light. Labels: "PREFILL" at the top of the left panel, "DECODE" at the top of the right panel, "MEMORY TRIPS" along the walking path.

key: A kitchen. SRAM is the masala dabba
name: ch09_kitchen_memory_hierarchy
alt: A cook's stove with a masala dabba beside it, a fridge a few steps away and a kirana shop down the road, showing near and far storage.
scene: A wide horizontal cutaway illustration read from left to right with increasing distance. On the far LEFT, a home cook, a woman in her 30s in a kurta with an apron and her hair tied up, stands at a gas stove stirring a kadai. Right beside the stove, within arm's reach, sits a small round steel masala dabba with seven little spice bowls, open and ready. A few steps to the RIGHT, inside the same kitchen, a tall refrigerator stands with its door open, full of vegetables, milk and a week's groceries. Further RIGHT, through an open window and down a long street, a small kirana shop with sacks and shelves is visible in the distance, its shopkeeper waving; a long dotted path with a tired walking figure shows a slow trip to the shop and back. Small distance markers under each: a hand icon, a few footsteps, and a long road. The stove flame burns steadily and never waits. Warm afternoon kitchen light, homely mood. Labels: "SRAM" under the masala dabba, "HBM" under the fridge, "CPU DRAM" under the kirana shop.

key: Railway berths. The old way reserves
name: ch09_railway_berths_pagedattention
alt: Split image of train coaches: one with a whole coupé reserved but half empty, the other with passengers seated in scattered berths tracked on a chart.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, each half a cutaway side view of an Indian sleeper-class train coach with blue berths in compartments. LEFT panel: an entire six-berth coupé is fenced off with a rope and a reserved sign; only two family members, a father in a sweater and a small daughter, sit inside while four berths stay empty with folded blankets, and in the corridor several passengers stand without seats, looking annoyed. RIGHT panel: the same coach, every berth filled with different passengers spread across various compartments, sleeping, reading or eating from tiffins; there are no empty berths. A friendly TTE in a black coat and white shirt stands in the aisle holding a clipboard chart with a grid of small numbered boxes, with thin dotted lines linking boxes on his chart to scattered passengers across the coach. Soft evening light through train windows, gentle rocking-train mood. Labels: "PRE-ALLOCATED" at the top of the left panel, "PAGEDATTENTION" at the top of the right panel, "BLOCK TABLE" on the TTE's chart.

key: Shared autos at a Bengaluru metro exi
name: ch09_shared_auto_batching
alt: Three shared autos at a metro exit show static, dynamic and continuous batching: waiting until full, leaving on a timer, and swapping passengers mid-route.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip illustration, panels separated by thin white gaps, each showing a green-and-yellow three-wheeler share auto near an elevated metro station exit with pillars and a staircase. PANEL ONE: the auto parked at the exit, two passengers inside looking at their watches impatiently, the driver in a khaki shirt leaning out and waving for more people, with three empty seat outlines highlighted. PANEL TWO: the same scene but a large clock above shows two minutes passed and the auto drives off half full, the driver shrugging. PANEL THREE: the auto on a busy tree-lined road, mid-journey, one passenger stepping out at a roadside stop with a shop sign reading "Indiranagar" while a new passenger with an office bag steps in at the same moment, all seats still full; motion lines show it never stopping long. A small arrow along the bottom connects all three. Bright morning light with traffic around. Labels: "STATIC" at the top of panel one, "DYNAMIC" at the top of panel two, "CONTINUOUS" at the top of panel three.

key: Sending a document to a photocopy shop
name: ch10_photocopy_sticky_note_pii
alt: A customer covers the Aadhaar number on a document with a sticky note before a photocopy shop copies it, then peels the note off at home.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a small Indian photocopy shop counter with a grey copier, stacks of paper and lamination sheets; a woman in her 30s in a kurta places a document on the glass, her hand pressing a bright yellow sticky note over one line of digits on an ID card printout; the shop assistant, a young man in a polo shirt, operates the copier and his eyes see only the yellow patch, a small dotted sight-line ending at the note. A copy emerges with a blank yellow-shaped rectangle where the number was. RIGHT panel: back at home at a wooden dining table under a lamp, the same woman peels the yellow sticky note off her original and places the photocopy beside it, the real number now visible only on her own document; a cup of tea and her handbag sit nearby, she looks satisfied. A small inset in the corner shows a magnifying glass missing one uncovered number on another page, hinting that masking is not a guarantee. Warm afternoon light, calm, reassuring mood. Labels: "MASK" by the sticky note, "MODEL" under the copier, "UNMASK" at the top of the right panel.

key: A chai stall at rush hour keeps a ket
name: ch10_chai_kettle_cache
alt: A chai vendor at rush hour pours plain chai from a ready kettle for most customers while brewing a special order fresh, never reusing a named cup.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated three-quarter view of a busy roadside chai stall outside a railway station at morning rush hour. A chai vendor in his 40s with a towel around his neck and a checked shirt stands behind a wooden counter. On the left side of the counter, a huge aluminium kettle of plain chai is kept warm on a low flame, and he pours from it rapidly into a row of small glasses that office workers grab and walk off with, a fast-moving line. On the right side of the counter, a small separate pan bubbles on a second stove where he freshly makes a special order: masala spices, a small sugar bowl and a carton of oat milk beside it, for a young woman in gym clothes who waits patiently. In the foreground, a paper cup with a name written on it sits on a shelf marked with a small red cross, deliberately not reused. A small clock above the kettle shows time passing, hinting at expiry. Bright early-morning light with steam rising, energetic mood. Labels: "CACHE HIT" above the big kettle, "CACHE MISS" above the fresh pan, "DO NOT CACHE" by the named cup.

key: A courier parcel. Metrics:
name: ch10_courier_parcel_trace
alt: Three views of a courier parcel's journey: a weekly late-delivery chart, a long log of scans, and a tracking timeline showing the parcel stuck two days at a hub.
scene: A wide horizontal illustration split into three stacked zones from left to right, set in a courier company's operations office with parcels on conveyor belts in the background. LEFT zone: a wall-mounted screen showing a simple bar chart with one small red bar and the figure "3%", a manager in a polo shirt glancing at it with coffee. MIDDLE zone: a very long paper printout spilling from a printer onto the floor in loose coils, covered with tiny repeated lines and scanner icons, a clerk in spectacles buried up to his knees in it. RIGHT zone: a large phone screen held by a customer, a young man in a hoodie, showing a vertical timeline of one parcel with connected dots: picked up in a city, a truck icon, a hub dot that is circled in red and marked with a small hourglass and "2 days" beside it, then onward to delivery. A dotted line connects the circled hub on the phone to a warehouse in the background where one box sits alone in a corner. Clean office daylight, investigative mood. Labels: "METRICS" over the left zone, "LOGS" over the middle zone, "TRACE" over the right zone.

key: A sabziwala doesn't hand out a feedbac
name: ch10_sabziwala_implicit_feedback
alt: A vegetable seller quietly observes a customer picking small tomatoes, frowning at capsicum prices and commenting on spinach, learning without a feedback form.
scene: A close, eye-level three-quarter view of a sabziwala's handcart piled with tomatoes, capsicum, spinach bundles, onions and green chillies, under a faded umbrella on a residential street. Behind the cart, an observant vegetable seller in his 50s with a white cap, a vest and a pencil behind his ear watches his customer with knowing eyes. The customer, a woman in her 40s in a cotton saree with a cloth bag, does three things shown in sequence by small numbered motion cues: her hand carefully picks only the smaller tomatoes from the heap; her face frowns at a small price tag on the capsicum; and she holds up a spinach bundle with a small speech bubble showing a spinach leaf and a backwards calendar arrow. Thin dotted lines run from each of these three actions to a small thought bubble above the seller, where he mentally notes them as tiny icons. On the cart's side, a blank paper feedback form is tucked away unused with a small cross over it. Soft morning street light, warm everyday mood. Labels: "IMPLICIT FEEDBACK" over the seller's thought bubble, "NO FORM" by the unused paper.

key: long train journey from Kanyakumari
name: ch11_kanyakumari_to_jammu_journey
alt: A long train crosses a map of India from Kanyakumari to Jammu, and a traveller steps off at the end ready to start using what she learned.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated panoramic illustration of a stylised map of India seen from above, with soft green plains, blue rivers and mountains in the north. A long blue express train winds from the southern tip of the map near the sea and a rocky coastline all the way up to the snow-capped hills in the far north. Along its route, small station markers dot the track, a few tiny chai stall icons with steam, and a running distance counter on a small sign reading "3,700 km". At the northern end, the train has stopped at a hill station platform, and a young woman traveller in her late 20s with a backpack, a shawl and a notebook steps down, looking back proudly at the long track behind her. Ahead of her, beyond the platform, a small workshop scene shows a laptop on a desk and tools laid out, with a path leading to it, showing the journey continuing into real work. Warm sunrise light in the north, a sense of accomplishment and a new beginning. Labels: "THE BOOK" along the train route, "START BUILDING" over the workshop at the end.

key: A good doctor does not start with the
name: ch11_doctor_asks_questions
alt: A doctor asks a patient a series of questions, narrowing a large cloud of possible diagnoses to a single answer, with medicine set aside until later.
scene: A wide, eye-level three-quarter view inside a small neighbourhood clinic with a wooden desk, a stethoscope, a blood-pressure machine, a calendar and a frosted glass window. A thoughtful doctor in her 50s with short grey hair, a white coat and reading glasses leans forward, counting questions on her fingers, with three speech bubbles showing simple icons: a clock, a pointing hand on a body outline, and a thermometer. Opposite her, a middle-aged patient in a checked shirt holding his stomach answers. Above the desk, a large funnel-shaped cloud fills the upper half of the image: at the wide top are dozens of tiny illness icons and question marks, and as the funnel narrows towards the bottom, the icons drop away with each question, until a single glowing answer card emerges at the narrow end. On the side of the desk, a closed medicine cupboard is pushed aside, deliberately not opened first. A small inset on the right shows a test tube and flask, hinting that some new problems need an experiment. Soft, calm clinic light. Labels: "QUESTIONS" beside the doctor, "ANSWER" at the narrow end of the funnel, "EVAL" by the test tube.

key: A batsman who only faces easy bowling
name: ch11_batsman_bouncers
alt: A young batsman faces gentle underarm bowling on one side, and fierce bouncers at night nets on the other, where his technique is truly built.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided down the middle by a thin vertical line, the same young batsman in both halves: a lanky teenager in cricket whites, pads, gloves and a helmet. LEFT panel: a sunny park on a lazy afternoon, an uncle in a vest gently lobs an underarm ball and the batsman casually swats it, yawning, with a bored dog lying in the grass; no improvement, a small flat line icon above him. RIGHT panel: a floodlit concrete net at night, a clock on the pavilion wall showing two o'clock, a tall fast bowler in a sweat-soaked jersey running in hard and a ball rising sharply towards the helmet; the batsman sways back with perfect form, focused and determined. Behind the nets stand a protective safety screen and a coach with a clipboard watching a monitor, representing guardrails and monitoring. A small upward line icon above him shows growth. Warm lazy light on the left, harsh dramatic floodlight on the right. Labels: "EASY CASES" at the top of the left panel, "REAL USERS" at the top of the right panel, "GUARDRAILS" on the safety screen.

key: The book is a full thali; an intervie
name: ch11_thali_map_interview
alt: A full thali seen from above with each bowl as a chapter, while an interviewer points at the dal and a candidate goes straight to it.
scene: A wide, slightly elevated top-down view of a large round steel thali on a wooden table, filled with eleven small steel bowls arranged in a ring around a heap of rice and two rotis in the centre: dal, sabzi, paneer, kadhi, raita, pickle, papad, sweet, salad, chutney and buttermilk, each bowl subtly different in colour. Each bowl has a tiny numbered flag stuck into it like a chapter marker. On the left side of the table, an interviewer in a formal shirt and lanyard sits with a notepad, pointing with a pen at the dal bowl, with a speech bubble showing a magnifying glass over a dal icon. On the right side, a confident candidate in his late 20s, wearing a neat collared shirt, already reaches straight for that exact bowl with a spoon, smiling. A small folded map card lies beside the thali, sketching the same ring of bowls. A faint dotted line joins the dal bowl with a neighbouring sabzi bowl, hinting that topics mix. Warm restaurant lighting, relaxed but focused mood. Labels: "THE BOOK" on the thali rim, "INTERVIEW QUESTION" over the interviewer's bubble, "MAP" on the folded card.
